metadata.source: CitiPower 2026-27 Pricing (structure) + CitiPower 2026-27 Tariff Summary (final, 7 May 2026; rates)
metadata.notes: Excluding GST. Residential ToU CRSTOU: peak 4pm-9pm, saver 11am-4pm, off-peak 9pm-11am, all days, rates from the CitiPower 2026-27 Tariff Summary (final, 7 May 2026; knowledge/documents/citipower/2026-11-10-tariff-summary-2026-27). Small business ToU peak is 9am-9pm workdays. Residential/export CER tariffs (CRCER) and all demand-charge tariffs (CG/CMG/CMGO21/large/HV/sub-transmission) are NOT seeded. The CER tariffs are priced in the 2026-27 Tariff Summary but not yet seeded; seeding them is tracked separately. The demand-charge tariffs are excluded because this schema's single demand-window model can't represent CitiPower's two-season (summer/non-summer) demand charge without inventing a modeling choice not made unilaterally. Source PDF gives tariff codes/structure but not $ rates -- those live in the CitiPower 2026-27 Tariff Summary (final, 7 May 2026), which gives the rates of every seeded tariff here (C1R, CDS, CRSTOU, C1G, CGTOU); the rows other than residential ToU are recorded in knowledge/findings/2026-11-10-victorian-2026-27-non-tou-network-rates (#73). The AER TSS.01 indicative-prices spreadsheet (Jan2025 proposal) is no longer a rate source for any seeded tariff.

tariffs.name: Residential ToU

The source states no time basis for this tariff; time_basis stays local (#68).

tariffs.notes: Rates checked 2026-11-10 against knowledge/documents/citipower/2026-11-10-tariff-summary-2026-27 (sheet CP_2026-27_NUOS row 10, excluding GST): fixed 0.00 c/day, dedicated circuit 1.00 c/kWh.
